findings.reasoning: CC-24-04 requires a License Agreement when street trees, landscaping, or irrigation are proposed in the public right-of-way. The condition If street trees/landscaping/irrigation in ROW is clearly met. Vision evidence confirms proposed street trees are located in the ROW on both the eastern frontage (S Lamar area, 7 trees) and within the Collier Street planting zone. Per Austin License Agreement requirements, any private improvements (including street trees and irrigation) occupying public ROW require city approval via License Agreement. No such agreement was found in the 13 supplementary documents or referenced on any sheets examined. This is a required submittal that is missing from the completeness check package.
findings.explanation: Proposed street trees shown in ROW (Sheet 51 shows 7 trees in eastern ROW; Sheet 14 shows planting zone in Collier St ROW), but no License Agreement submitted or referenced.
findings.resolution: Submit License Agreement application for street trees and irrigation in the public right-of-way along S Lamar Blvd and Collier Street, or remove street trees from the ROW and relocate to private property.

findings.observation: Reviewed Sheet 6 (General Notes) Block 3 ADDITIONAL REVIEW ACKNOWLEDGEMENT section. The AULCC REQUIREMENT subsection asks: DOES THIS PROJECT REQUIRE AULCC REVIEW? (>300 LF OF W/WW PIPING IN ROW) - the YES checkbox is marked. The form states IF YES, PLEASE PROVIDE UCC# and shows (pending). This indicates the applicant acknowledges AULCC review is required due to exceeding 300 LF of water/wastewater piping in ROW, but the AULCC case number (UCC#) is pending, meaning the AULCC Completeness Letter has not yet been obtained. Facts.md confirms the site is NOT in the Downtown Austin Project Coordination Zone (DAPCZ), so the 300 LF threshold (not 25 LF) applies. Sheet 6 AW Infrastructure Information table shows 44 LF of 12 water main, plus service lines - but the applicants own acknowledgement states >300 LF total W/WW in ROW. Conducted semantic search for AULCC references - found only the Sheet 6 acknowledgement form, no AULCC case number or Completeness Letter in supplementary documents.
findings.reasoning: CC-24-15 requires AULCC coordination when excavations exceed 300 LF outside DAPCZ (or 25 LF within DAPCZ). The project is outside DAPCZ, so the 300 LF threshold applies. The condition If excavations exceed AULCC thresholds is explicitly met by the applicants own acknowledgement on Sheet 6 that AULCC review is required for >300 LF of W/WW piping in ROW. However, the UCC# (AULCC case number) is listed as pending, which means the required AULCC Completeness Letter has not been submitted or referenced. Per Code section 14-11-165 and UCM section 3.2.0, AULCC review must be completed and the case number/Completeness Letter must be in the submittal. The pending status indicates this required coordination has not been completed, which is a completeness deficiency.
findings.explanation: Sheet 6 confirms AULCC required (>300 LF W/WW in ROW), but AULCC case number is pending; Completeness Letter not submitted.
findings.resolution: Submit plans to AULCC for review, obtain AULCC case number and Completeness Letter, and update Sheet 6 with the assigned UCC# before site plan approval.

findings.observation: Per the grouping file Key Terms section, AULCC coordination is required when any License Agreement or tower crane is involved. Analysis of preceding items establishes: (1) No tower crane is proposed (CC-24-01). (2) Street trees/landscaping/irrigation in ROW ARE proposed and require a License Agreement (CC-24-04). (3) The License Agreement has not been submitted (CC-24-13). Sheet 6 shows AULCC is required and acknowledged, but only in the context of >300 LF OF W/WW PIPING IN ROW (CC-24-15). There is no separate reference to AULCC coordination for the License Agreement work (street trees/landscaping). The grouping file overview states: Right-of-Way Management requires AULCC review when excavations exceed 25 linear feet in DAPCZ or 300 linear feet outside DAPCZ, or when a License Agreement or tower crane is involved. These are separate triggers. While the excavation trigger is acknowledged, the License Agreement trigger for AULCC is not addressed on the plans.
findings.reasoning: CC-24-16 requires AULCC coordination when a License Agreement or tower crane is involved. The condition is met because street trees in ROW require a License Agreement (per CC-24-04 analysis). Per the grouping overview and Key Terms, License Agreements independently trigger AULCC coordination regardless of excavation lengths. The AULCC acknowledgement on Sheet 6 addresses only the excavation-length trigger (>300 LF W/WW in ROW), not the License Agreement trigger. Since street trees/landscaping in ROW necessitate both a License Agreement AND AULCC coordination for that License Agreement work, and neither has been properly submitted or referenced, this item fails. The applicant must coordinate with AULCC for all triggers - both the utility excavation work and the License Agreement work. The pending UCC# status suggests this coordination is incomplete.
findings.explanation: Street trees in ROW require License Agreement, which triggers AULCC coordination; AULCC for License Agreement work not separately referenced (Sheet 6 only addresses excavation trigger).
findings.resolution: Coordinate AULCC review for License Agreement work (street trees/landscaping in ROW) in addition to the utility excavation work already acknowledged. Update plans to reference AULCC coordination for all applicable triggers.
